title: EPFO platform POC

home.heading: Provident fund services, demonstrated
home.intro: Explore the synthetic services and role workspaces available in this proof of concept.
home.signIn: Sign in with a demo persona
home.exploreDescription: See interface coverage, role activities and the demo accounts available to try.

claim.title: A member's claim through the office
claim.description: File a claim, follow the officer's checks and approval, and see it paid.

return.title: An employer's monthly return and payment
return.description: Prepare and validate an ECR, then approve, submit and pay through the simulated bank.

pension.title: A pension from Form 10D to the PPO
pension.description: Follow a retired member's application through the pension desks to the signed PPO.

death.title: A death claim and the EDLI benefit
death.description: File as a nominee, review the death claim and record the EDLI benefit decision.

transfer.title: Changing jobs: auto-transfer and the primary member ID
transfer.description: Confirm an auto-transfer and explore why previous service must reach the primary member ID.

compliance.title: Compliance: defaulters, demands and VISHWAS
compliance.description: Review defaulting establishments, settle demands and follow the VISHWAS case.

grievance.title: A grievance, with or without a login
grievance.description: File and track a grievance, then follow the office's reply; a public form is also available.

oversight.title: Oversight: concurrent audit and the Issue Tracker
oversight.description: Raise an audit alert, reply from the regional office and execute an approved Issue Tracker request.

interface.login: Choose a persona to see the endpoints that role may call.
interface.none: This role has no endpoints in this interface.
interface.description: Review stakeholder coverage and the endpoint status for this synthetic interface.

portal.subtitle: Synthetic demonstration portal
portal.disclaimer: Synthetic demonstration — not an official EPFO system. No real personal data.
portal.built: Built as an API-first proof of concept

passbook.title: My passbook
passbook.description: View credited contributions across your linked synthetic accounts.
passbook.pendingDescription: These filings are not credited yet. The amount will appear once the employer’s payment is confirmed.
passbook.emptyDescription: Credited contributions will appear here after payment confirmation.

claims.title: My claims
claims.description: Explore illustrative eligibility, start a claim, and follow its progress.
claims.illustrativeNotice: DEMO · Claim rules and amounts are illustrative. No real claim or payment is made.
claims.noAccounts: No linked accounts are available for a claim.
claims.wholeRupees: Enter a whole number of rupees.
claims.invalidAmount: Enter a whole rupee amount above zero and within the maximum for this claim.

claimDetail.title: Claim details
claimDetail.newBankHelp: The bank could not pay into your account. Enter an account in your name; the bank checks it, then an APFC approves the re-payment.

profile.title: Profile & notices
profile.description: Your masked details, identity status, employment, and notices.
profile.name: Name

office.queueDescription: Cases assigned to your office role.
office.caseDescription: Review the case and its approval history.
office.actionSaved: Action recorded. The case and work queue have been refreshed.
office.reasonRequired: Enter a reason for return or rejection.
office.demoPaymentNotice: DEMO · This simulates a bank outcome. No funds move.
office.advisoryHelp: A routine check on recent account activity asks you to review this claim normally. It is not evidence and must not decide the outcome.
office.redisbursementSummary: {{decision}} the re-payment of claim {{claimId}} to the member's new bank account.
office.redisbursementHelp: The bank returned the payment and the member gave a new account that passed the (mock) penny-drop check. Approving changes only where the money goes; the claim decision is not reopened.

grievances.title: Grievances
grievances.description: Tell us what went wrong. Your regional office replies; you can escalate if it takes too long.
grievances.subject: Subject
grievances.documentHelp: PDF, PNG, JPEG or text, up to 256 KB. Use synthetic documents only in this demo.
grievances.none: You have not filed any grievances.
grievances.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than 256 KB.
grievances.withTier: With the {{tier}}; a reply is due by {{due}}.
grievances.escalateHelp: If the office has not helped, send the grievance to the next level.
grievances.reopenHelp: You can reopen a resolved grievance within 30 days.

security.title: Account security
security.description: Keep your contact details right, see where you are signed in, and tell us if something looks wrong.
security.contactHelp: Needs a one-time code. We keep only masked values.
security.changed: Contact details changed. If this was not you, report it below.
security.changeSummary: Change the mobile number and email on your account.
security.sessionsHelp: If you see a session you do not recognise, report it and ask for account recovery.
security.reported: Thank you. The security team will review it.
security.recoveryHelp: A security analyst reviews the request and can restore your last verified contact details. Nothing changes until then.
security.recoveryRequested: Recovery requested. A security analyst will review it.
security.recoverySummary: Ask EPFO to review your account and restore your last verified contact details.

assistant.title: Ask the assistant
assistant.description: Answers come only from approved help documents, with their sources. The assistant cannot see or change your account.
assistant.question: Your question
assistant.example1: How much can I withdraw as a medical advance?
assistant.example2: How is a large claim decided?
assistant.example3: How long does a claim take? Community FAQ
assistant.notice: Advisory only. Rules shown are illustrative for this demonstration, not the official EPF Scheme. The assistant never shares anyone's personal details.

modes.llm: Written by the model from the sources

assistant.ignored: A retrieved document ({{refs}}) contained instructions to the assistant. They were treated as text, not followed, and not quoted.
assistant.feedbackThanks: Thank you. Your feedback is reviewed by people; the assistant is not changed automatically.
assistant.unverified: unverified — not used for the answer

correction.title: Correct my details (Joint Declaration)
correction.help: Your employer confirms the correction, then your regional office checks and approves it. Major changes (name, date of birth, gender) are approved by an APFC.
correction.summary: Ask your employer and the regional office to correct your details.
correction.sent: Sent ({{id}}). You will get a notice at each step.

tax.title: Form 15G / 15H — no tax payable this year
tax.help: If your total income this financial year is not taxable, declare it once so that no income tax is deducted from PF withdrawals paid this year (where the policy allows it). Form 15H is for people aged 60 or more. Illustrative only.
tax.declare: I declare that my estimated total income for this financial year is not chargeable to income tax.

pensionEstimate.title: Your pension estimate (EPS)
pensionEstimate.help: Service so far: {{years}} years {{months}} months; pensionable salary {{salary}} a month. A monthly pension needs at least {{min}} years of service.
